description: Scope-(b) structural exclusion: neither nuc11_interleaved proton nor neutron word is a gamma-gamma-produced ELEMENT. Invariant: the alternating character, fixed at 1 for every gamma-gamma word by GammaGammaWordSelection.altChar_eq_one (sorry-free). Both are strictly negative for every q>0, so the exclusion holds by sign. Element-level, unlike the word-level parity argument. Excludes THIS element only -- the 6-letter core IS gamma-gamma-produced.

data.degree_argument: deg a_k = |k| - 1 for |k| >= 1, so a_k is the constant 1 only at k = +-1; the finite scan -8..8 corroborates the degree argument, it does not stand in for it.
data.scope: CHECK 4 is scope-(b): a STRUCTURAL EXCLUSION of the scored element from the gamma-gamma class, with the invariant named -- the alternating character, fixed at 1 by QOU.Mass.GammaGammaWordSelection.altChar_eq_one (sorry-free). A character is an algebra hom, so this is ELEMENT-level and survives any rewriting of the word, unlike the word-level parity argument (gammaGamma_length_even) which re-padding to even length defeats.
data.what_this_does_not_say: (1) The gamma-gamma ROUTE is not excluded: the 6-letter core IS gamma-gamma-produced, altChar 1 (CHECK 3). Only THIS element is excluded. (2) No contradiction with the owner ruling qou-ales, which used a gamma-gamma criterion to DISCRIMINATE BETWEEN two census candidates and did not certify either as gamma-gamma-produced; what fails is reading the witness field element_is_ruled: true as 'the scored element is gamma-gamma-produced'. (3) It identifies no replacement element and does not claim one exists.
